chronicleInitializationFinding.sourceCause: src/versus.js init assigns artDiagnostic.checked from debugArt before populating the roster. The old recipe waited for the raw HTML input plus250ms, so it could select the checkbox before init reset it.
chronicleInitializationFinding.recipeCorrection: Wait for the roster button produced by init before the existing250ms/autostart wait and diagnostic check, both in the chronicle launch and shell Continue iframe. No engine startup or art gate changed.
